2609.26760.title: Grow the Harness, Not the Context: From Strategy-Free Scaffolds to Reusable Specialist Agents
2609.26760.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often handle streams of related tasks, yet standard harnesses repeatedly ask the model to reconstruct the same control decisions inside each task's context. We study whether task feedback can instead turn recurring control into reusable executable code, while reserving LLM calls for task-specific semantic reasoning. We introduce Growing Harness, a failure-guided training paradigm that learns the agent harness itself from a strategy-free scaffold that exposes fixed model and tool interfaces but encodes no task-solving controller. Function-level execution traces localize each failure to a bounded code surface, an optimizer repairs a window of failures jointly, and a success-first held-out gate rolls back repair sequences that harm prior capability. Accepted edits accumulate in one shared harness, allowing its control structure to emerge from task feedback. Across BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena-Verified with three deployment models from 4B to 120B parameters, Growing Harness achieves the highest mean success in five of six benchmark-model settings and trails the best mean by 0.7 pp. in the sixth. Relative to a Tool-Calling agent, it reduces LLM calls by 76.0-91.8% and deployed-agent inference cost by 74.4-98.6%. On WebArena-Verified, its success remains 44.7-45.3% across model scales, whereas Tool-Calling falls to 6.7% with the 4B model. Ablations show that trace-local edits, joint repair, and gate-based rollback each improve final success. These results show that persistent program growth can move recurring control out of model context and into low-cost code, yielding reusable specialist agents that remain effective with smaller deployment models.
2609.26760.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理通常處理一系列相關任務，但標準的框架卻不斷要求模型在每個任務的上下文中重建相同的控制決策。<lb/>我們研究任務反饋是否可以將重複的控制轉變為可重用的可執行代碼，同時將LLM調用保留用於任務特定的語義推理。<lb/>我們介紹了Growing Harness，一種失敗引導的訓練範式，從一個無策略的支架中學習代理框架，該支架暴露固定的模型和工具接口，但不編碼任何任務解決控制器。<lb/>函數級執行跟蹤將每個失敗定位到有限的代碼表面，優化器共同修復一段失敗窗口，而成功優先的保留閘則回滾那些損害先前能力的修復序列。<lb/>被接受的編輯累積在一個共享框架中，允許其控制結構從任務反饋中出現。<lb/>在BrowseComp-Plus和WebArena-Verified中，使用從4B到120B參數的三種部署模型，Growing Harness在六個基準模型設置中的五個中達到了最高的平均成功率，而在第六個中落後於最佳平均值0.7個百分點。<lb/>相較於Tool-Calling代理，它將LLM調用減少了76.0-91.8%，並將部署代理的推理成本降低了74.4-98.6%。<lb/>在WebArena-Verified上，其成功率在模型規模上保持在44.7-45.3%，而Tool-Calling在4B模型中降至6.7%。<lb/>消融實驗顯示，跟蹤本地編輯、聯合修復和基於閘的回滾各自提高了最終成功率。<lb/>這些結果顯示，持續的程序增長可以將重複控制從模型上下文中移出，進入低成本代碼，從而產生可重用的專家代理，並在較小的部署模型中保持有效。
